name: Armoured Revenant Reign
creator: kaizen
description:
No more bare-chested Viego! If you actually shelled out for the Revenant Reign exalted skin, and you feel that the sword changing is not enough, then this is for you - each form has its own, themed armour now. 
It also included a version with changed ability icons, to be themed after the skin.

Do keep it in mind this will not let you play with Revenant Reign if you don't have it.
